article_title: Right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority

groups.principle: Disclosure of the right to complain to a supervisory authority
groups.reason: The company policy lists several data subject rights under Section 6 (Access, Rectification, Erasure, Data Portability, Object), but it completely fails to inform data subjects of their right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
